verdict.rationale: Pulumi ships an official, documented CLI ([pulumi-probe-5], [pulumi-docs-37]). Its commands suit scripted and agent-driven use: `pulumi preview` as a dry run, `pulumi import`, `pulumi do` for direct resource operations, and `pulumi api` for calling any Pulumi Cloud REST endpoint. Documented exit codes are meant for scripts and tools, and Pulumi positions this code-first workflow for coding agents like Claude Code and Codex, backed by Agent Skills. Missing for 10: evidence of machine-readable (e.g. JSON) output modes for agents, and independent hands-on reports of AI agents driving the CLI.
